lead_outcomes.reason: The organiser's own call (Congress of Local and Regional Authorities of the Council of Europe, call dated 4 November 2026, deadline 30 November 2026) lists under 'Profile of candidates' the requirement: 'live in and hold the passport of one of the 46 Council of Europe member States'. The profile records nationality and residence as the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which is not a Council of Europe member State and is not mentioned on the call. The call does fund travel, subsistence and accommodation, but only for delegates who meet that rule. The call is a PDF on rm.coe.int (HTTP 200 to the repo reader as a binary PDF, so the text was extracted from those bytes with a PDF parser; WebFetch gets 403); the aggregator page named by the lead (opportunitiesforyouth.org) reproduces the same sentence.

AFRODAD's own vacancies page lists 'January - June 2027 Internship Positions (call for applications)' with deadline '20 Nov 2026' and status 'Closed'; the call document on afrodad.org gives the deadline as '12noon (SAT), Friday 20th November 2026'. The call names no stipend and no nationality rule (the title speaks of young African graduates). It recurs twice a year: the same page lists an 'Internship Program | July - December 2026' call (10 Jun 2026), 'AFRODAD Internship Program (January - June 2026)' (31 Oct 2025) and 'Internship Program (July - December 2025)' (24 May 2025). Watch the vacancies page for the July - December 2027 call (expected around May-June 2027).

The aggregator page (lesopportunites.com) is only a list of 50 links to app.unv.org opportunity pages grouped by country (10 under 'Congo RDC'), each labelled just 'Poste 1', 'Poste 2' and so on, with no job title, deadline, volunteer category or eligibility rule, so it is not itself an opportunity. The linked app.unv.org pages cannot be read here: both the repo reader and WebFetch get only the empty JavaScript shell titled 'UVP - Unified Volunteer Platform', and www.unv.org itself answered with an Incapsula bot-check page ('Request unsuccessful. Incapsula incident ID ...') after one successful home-page read, so no UNV condition of service (age, nationality, living allowance) could be read. Nothing was worked around. Whether a current UNV assignment in the DRC (or abroad) is open to this profile needs a browser: open https://app.unv.org/ and filter by Democratic Republic of the Congo; the UN Volunteers programme itself deserves a record once its official pages can be read.

Fee-based and unverifiable. The only page found is the aggregator post itself, which says 'Complete the Form and pay the required application fees' and lists 'Forum fee waiver of up to $500' (so a forum fee exists) plus a self-funded 'Direct Forum Access' category. The organiser is named only as 'Youth Diplomatic Academy (YDA)'; the post links no official event page of its own, two web searches found no official YDA website (only copies of the same post on other aggregators, one of which gives an application fee of $29), and its two application forms are Cognito Forms pages that show only a title to the readers. The 'fully funded' wording therefore exists only on aggregators and is attached to a paid application.

The Xes Jeux de la Francophonie (Yerevan, 23 July - 1 August 2027) admit only competitors chosen by their own state: the CIJF page says 'La participation aux Xes Jeux de la Francophonie est conditionnée à une présélection nationale officielle'. Its calendar ends with 'Avril - juin 2026 : Envoi des dossiers des 3 candidats par discipline', '29 juillet 2026 : Délibérations des jurys et du comité de sélection' and '7 septembre 2026 : Publication d'une première liste officielle des concurrents', so the cultural preselections are over; sport places go through national federations. Congo (RD) is listed as a registered state (contact: Délégation générale à la Francophonie) but is not among the states with retained cultural candidates. The per-participant fee of 600 euro covers local transport, meals and accommodation only, so the flight is not stated as covered. No record written; the next Games are the XIes in 2031 (Senegal).

WebFetch (volunteer-abroad page): empty content. Tools tried: repo reader, WebFetch. Not worked around.
